subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: For read-only exec-like tool failures that deliver zero user-facing payloads, should OpenClaw surface a compact tool-failed warning, the generic incomplete-turn fallback, or continue suppressing both by default?
rationale: Current main already handles mutating exec failures and empty non-image replay, but changing the read-only failure/fallback behavior affects channel noise, retry safety, and terminal-state semantics.

options.title: Show compact warning on silent read-only exec failure
options.body: Use the existing warning surface only when no user-facing reply was delivered, preserving suppression after a real assistant answer.

options.title: Prefer incomplete-turn fallback
options.body: Allow the generic incomplete-turn fallback when payloadCount is zero even if lastToolError is present, avoiding tool-specific warning copy.

options.title: Wait for placeholder PRs first
options.body: Keep warning/fallback semantics unchanged until the broader placeholder cluster lands, then reassess with live channel proof.

recommendation.title: Show compact warning on silent read-only exec failure
recommendation.body: Use the existing warning surface only when no user-facing reply was delivered, preserving suppression after a real assistant answer.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the terminal-classifier follow-up that most directly owns the terminal-state contract involved here.
